scientific_scope_status: For finite column-stochastic K,L with common n-input alphabet and m_K,m_L nonzero output rows, define J_K=D(Krho||Ksigma)-D(rho_R||sigma_R), only with finite terms. For Q_i>0 summing to I and complex zero-sum u_i, let W_y=sum_i k_yi Q_i, v_y=sum_i k_yi u_i and F_K=sum_y v_y* W_y^-1 v_y. The conditional/equal-reference coefficient is sup F_K/F_L in active dimensions<=n-1+m_K+m_L; reference dimension<=n+m_K+m_L suffices. Rational-channel finite coefficients are algebraic and rational threshold comparison is decidable in principle. A separately credited post-exposure reviewer inference sharpens active dimension to m_K and reference dimension to m_K+1.
